question: Which of the following actions will move a file to the Recycle Bin in Windows?

options.text: Press Enter on the selected file

solution:
The correct answer is __**Right-click the file → Select Delete**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• In Microsoft Windows, deleting a file via the **right-click menu** and selecting "Delete" will move the file to the **Recycle Bin**, instead of permanently deleting it.
 
• The Recycle Bin acts as a temporary storage, allowing users to recover files that were deleted accidentally.</li&
